decisions.reason: The source's expansion of labels to all control fields is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Applying interface labels to all control fields does not change the Word document default-language configuration.
The label-scope decision does not change legacy copy-paste layout or style stability.
Control-field label coverage does not alter bullet sizing, balance, alignment, or color.
The source decision concerns labels on control fields and does not alter pasted-table or column containment requirements.
Persistent help labels are distinct from the grey visual cue used to identify editable fields.
Extending labels to all control fields does not change whether a placeholder clears when its field is activated.
The label coverage decision does not change the underlying representation or architecture of text-entry fields.
Control-field labels do not affect Tab-based list hierarchy or nested-list alignment.
The source does not change heading, title, or caption typography.
The decision to place labels on all control fields does not change the required theme colors.
Although date pickers may be control fields, the source changes label coverage rather than the calendar-dropdown selection behavior.
